content.short: Rarity Sniper lets users check NFT collection rarity across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Avalanche.
content.description: Rarity Sniper, launched in 2021, is a platform built to help users locate the rarest NFTs within a collection. It allows exploring new collections and drops, while providing up-to-date NFT news and statistics. Developers can use the tool to investigate collections and analyze stats, aiding research and discovery. The platform has helped identify highly rare NFTs from projects like Bored Ape Kennel Club, Cool Cats, and other notable drops.
